gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Distinctive from the first glance, Happy Monkey keeps a ruler-straight line weight. Noto Sans Kawi sits below with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, a quiet body that never competes with the display heading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-mongoli: Plain sans in feel, Noto Sans Mongolian lets its terminals flare outward, modern and unshowy. But across pages of text, it would keep moving smoothly while Happy Monkey's marker-drawn plainness stays up top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-nko: Wide gaps in every e and a ruler-straight line weight give Happy Monkey its bold, unmistakable look. Noto Sans NKo lets you see through its c openings, modern and light.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans is a contemporary sans-serif with generous c terminals. Happy Monkey brings ruler-straight strokes without pinched joints or flared ends, so loud meets low and neither gets lost.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ruluko: Loud, ruler-straight strokes from Happy Monkey, with Ruluko as the plain sans below. And its broad open counters on c and s keep paragraphs of text feeling approachable, never tiring.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: A drawn-wire swagger: that's Happy Monkey up top. Sawarabi Gothic, a sans with open jaws on every curved stroke, looks best with its size nudged up a notch so those jaws can show.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-suse: SUSE feels approachable, its curves carrying the heft of a rope's body. Against the bold, ruler-straight lines of Happy Monkey, those ladle-tipped open bowls feel soft and plainly spoken.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tajawal: Flat as fineliner on paper, Happy Monkey makes a loud entrance. Tajawal has a c shaped like a broad open hook, and a slightly larger size for it lets that shape show.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tirra: Outlined letters traced with a single pen width: that is Happy Monkey. Tirra, plain sans with round forms that look like open parentheses, gives that rigid line something soft to lean against.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-wix-madefor-displ: Wix Madefor Display feels contemporary, a sans whose gently flared curve ends stay clear of one another. Happy Monkey leads with fixed-width, router-bit strokes while the body quietly follows.
